title: Sandino: the fight against the US Marines, 1927-1934
goal: Tell the story of Augusto C. Sandino and imagine what would have happened, with si + hubiera + participle.
grammar: past conditions with si + pluperfect subjunctive (review)

sections.title: Sandino: the fight against the US Marines, 1927-1934
body: In this lesson you read about Augusto C. Sandino and the war in the mountains of Nicaragua between 1927 and 1933. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for talking about what did not happen: *si* + *hubiera* + participle, then *habría* + participle.

items: I can say what would have happened if something had been different, with *si hubiera… habría…*.
I can tell why Sandino refused the pact of Tipitapa.
I can give the main dates of Sandino's story.
